entry.title: Erdős #257: a checked weighted theorem and an open question
entry.summary: A Lean-checked finite-prime weighted condition proves irrationality for every infinite subset of a qualifying exponent set at every integer base. The paper constructs a set beyond reciprocal summability. The unrestricted #257 question remains open. The site links the short and long papers, a cross-problem synthesis, and routes for proof experiments and software changes.

entry.title: Microcosm became Plectis
entry.summary: Plectis became the preferred public name, with Microcosm retained only as a historical and compatibility label. The acknowledgement is source-backed and does not imply endorsement or affiliation.
